verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says a prebuilt image of the open-source branch is published to GitHub Container Registry, bundling headless Chrome, LibreOffice and CJK fonts, so Reader runs in a container without building it. A self-hosted deployment can also point at an S3-compatible bucket for caching. Missing for 10: production-deployment guidance (configuration, scaling, health checks), clarity on how the open-source branch differs from the hosted SaaS (e.g. the SaaS-only proxy pool), and independent or hands-on corroboration of running the container in production.
